items: for L1 use the locked-source serial em_scm_xy build path; do not require MPI merely because full HRRR later uses distributed-memory execution
before compilation require a working NetCDF-Fortran binding compatible with the chosen compiler plus the locked csh build driver
preserve the canonical NetCDF I/O contract instead of changing io_form values to bypass a missing library
if locked WRF3.9 fails with the modern compiler, record the first reproducible incompatibility before introducing any compatibility patch
do not interpret toolchain closure or SCM compilation as effective-radius numerical evidence
keep ReplayStatus source_callpath_authenticated until the existing L3 state-source-aligned checkpoint gate is met
add ToolchainCapabilityVector and BuildModeIdentity to experiment provenance
distinguish HardDependency, OptionalParallelDependency, ArtifactFormatDependency and BuildDriverDependency
record language-interface readiness separately when a library family exposes C and Fortran bindings
no physical promotion from R25; toolchain readiness is upstream engineering evidence only
